Starsand Island – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Starsand Island launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on August 18, 2026: https://ninten.do/6003aBRjN 

Escape the hustle of everyday life and discover a cozy paradise in Starsand Island! Farm, fish, build your dream home, explore breathtaking landscapes, and connect with charming neighbors. Relax on your own or share the journey with friends in online multiplayer. See you on the island! 

#StarsandIsland
